name: Dumpty
source:
Guardian of the Mad Hatter's mansion.
Even though he doesn't look it, he's Humpty's twin brother.
Their known as the Mad Eggs, or Mad Twins.
He loves creepy things. He thinks the self obsessed Humpty is weird, so he's interested in him too.
Aside from his weird interest, he's a serious and pretty normal guy.
